description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md under news-scraper/ to understand the programmatic API (`crawl_and_return_json`) and the exact output format. (2) Invoke `crawl_and_return_json(site='aibase', limit=20)` via the Python API (adding 'news-scraper' to sys.path) to retrieve the 10 mock articles. (3) Classify each article into one of the 8 valid categories (大模型, AI应用, 企业商业, 安全合规, 开源社区, 硬件芯片, 学术研究, 智能体) and assign tags from the 11-item taxonomy (OpenAI, Google, NVIDIA, Meta, Microsoft, 阿里巴巴, 中国, 国际, Agent, 多模态, 安全). (4) Group articles by category and write the output using the exact markdown format: a `📅 YYYY-MM-DD AI资讯` header, `---` separators, bold category headers with preceding emoji (e.g., `🧠 **智能体**`), and for each article a four-line blockquote block: `> 📌 标题：`, `> 🏷️ 分类：X | 标签：Y、Z`, `> 📝 概要：`, `> 🔗 链接：`. The proprietary traps are: (a) URLs must use the `/zh/news/` Chinese path as specified in SKILL.md, not a generic URL; (b) categories and tags must be from the fixed Chinese-language taxonomy only; (c) the specific emoji-per-category mapping and blockquote structure is unique to this skill and cannot be guessed from general knowledge; (d) articles must be grouped under category section headers, not listed flat. Save output as `ai_news_digest.md`.
